Antec Flux Pro Full Tower Case Specifications

The Antec Flux Pro is a premium, high-airflow full tower chassis designed for extreme cooling and high-end hardware. Featuring the patented F-LUX Platform, it provides a massive amount of airflow directly to the GPU and CPU. It is distinguished by its refined aesthetics, including genuine wood accents (walnut) and a built-in digital display.

Core Specifications

  • Case Type: Full Tower

  • Dimensions: 530 x 239 x 529 mm (DWH)

  • Materials: Steel, Plastic, Tempered Glass, Walnut Wood

  • Motherboard Support: E-ATX (up to 285mm), ATX, Micro-ATX, ITX

  • Weight: ~13.5 kg

Cooling & Fans (6 Pre-installed)

  • Front: 3 x 140mm PWM Fans (Pre-installed)

  • PSU Shroud: 2 x 120mm Reverse PWM Fans (Pre-installed for GPU cooling)

  • Rear: 1 x 140mm PWM Fan (Pre-installed)

  • Total Fan Support: Up to 12 fans (Front, Top, Rear, PSU Shroud, and Side)

Radiator Support

  • Top: 360mm / 420mm

  • Front: 360mm / 420mm

  • Rear: 120mm / 140mm
